weekTheme: Settle into Marathahalli with easy commutes, warm tiffins, and friendly local chats.

recommendedNeighbourhoods.fitReason: Walkable to Bagmane IT park with many PG and tiffin options.
Quick ORR commute north to Marathahalli with peaceful residential lanes.
Short bus ride along ORR with modern co-living spaces nearby.

missions.title: Morning auto ride to Bagmane
missions.whyItMatters: Builds confidence negotiating your daily commute in simple Kannada.
missions.whyThisPlace: A popular morning pickup spot just outside your office zone.
missions.objective: Ask the driver to use the meter to Bagmane IT park.
successCriteria: Politely request a meter ride in Kannada
Confirm the drop point near the office gate
hintLadder: Start with a warm namaskara greeting
Ask meter haaki for a meter ride

missions.title: Quick breakfast at Mayura Sagar
missions.whyItMatters: Darshinis offer fast, delicious morning meals before your workday begins.
missions.whyThisPlace: Just half a kilometer from Bagmane IT park for quick tiffins.
missions.objective: Order idli vada and filter coffee at the counter.
successCriteria: Thank the owner after receiving your token
hintLadder: Say namaskara at the billing counter
Ask for idli vada and coffee
Say dhanyavaada when taking your token

missions.title: Touring Staylix Co-living PG
missions.whyItMatters: Visiting in person helps you check room light and ventilation.
missions.whyThisPlace: Very close to your office for an easy daily walk.
missions.objective: Ask about private room availability and included meals.
successCriteria: Check if daily meals and laundry are included
hintLadder: Greet the manager politely at reception
Ask for a single sharing room tour
Confirm meal timings and house rules

missions.title: Catching the bus at Marathahalli
missions.whyItMatters: Knowing bus stops saves time during busy ORR peak hours.
missions.whyThisPlace: A major transit hub connecting Marathahalli to the rest of Bengaluru.
missions.objective: Ask which BMTC bus heads back toward Bagmane IT park.
successCriteria: Ask for the right bus route number
Confirm which side of the road to wait
hintLadder: Excuse yourself politely with a smile
Ask which platform or side to stand

missions.title: Friday evening tea at Parco
missions.whyItMatters: Relaxing with a colleague turns a new neighbourhood into home.
missions.whyThisPlace: A cozy neighborhood bakery less than a kilometer from office.
missions.objective: Share your first week impressions and thank your buddy.
successCriteria: Share one favorite spot from your week
Thank your buddy for helping you settle in
hintLadder: Mention a place you liked this week
